scenario.name: Corridor that opens to the right
scenario.heading: N
scenario.expected: Reaches (4,0) at tick 4 and stops for ticks 5-9 with front, left, and right blocked. Moves backward for ticks 10-14 to (4,5). There the right is open, so it turns right for ticks 15-19 (C5, C9) and goes forward east with cleaning from tick 20.
